deals.sellers: Mitsui & Co., Ltd. (TSE:8031); Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation; Mitsui & Co. Global Investment, Inc.; Mitsui Knowledge Industry Co., Ltd.
deals.comment: Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) acquired 90.69% stake in Curiocity Corp from Mitsui & Co. Ltd. (TSE:8031), Mitsui Knowledge Industry Co., Ltd. (TSE:2665), Mitsui & Co. Global Investment, Inc., Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation and its fund MVC Global Japan Fund I for ¥123 million on March 31, 2005. For the year ended on March 31, 2004, Curiocity Corp reported total assets of ¥175 million, common equity of ¥130 million, net loss of ¥79 million and net sales of ¥500 million. The shares are expected to be transferred on April 5, 2005 and the transaction will have no impact on the performance of Yahoo Japan Corporation in the fiscal year ending on March 2005.

deals.sellers: Nippon Venture Capital Co., Ltd.; JAFCO Group Co., Ltd. (TSE:8595); BELLSYSTEM24, Inc.; Yasuda Enterprise Development Co. Ltd.; VCN Group Inc.
deals.comment: Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE: 4689) signed a fundamental agreement to acquire 58.16% stake in Info Plant Co., Ltd. from Masaki Otani, VCN Group Inc., JAFCO L2 Venture Capital Investment Enterprise Partnership managed by JAFCO Co., Ltd. (TSE: 8595), Bellsystem24 Inc., Nippon Venture Capital Co., Ltd. and Yasuda Enterprise Development Co. Ltd. for ¥3 billion on July 20, 2005. Info Plant had sales of ¥1.4 billion, operating profit of ¥43 million, net income of ¥10 million, total assets of ¥1.3 billion and shareholders’ equity of ¥1 billion in 2004. The deal is expected to close in October 2005. The addition of this new subsidiary will have minor impact on the consolidated performance of Yahoo Japan Corporation in the fiscal year ending March 2006.

Yahoo Japan Corp., agreed to acquire 69% stake in NewsWatch Inc., from Toshiba Corp., for approximately ¥1.32 billion on March 24, 2006. The consideration includes cash and cash equivalents of ¥256 million. Toshiba currently holds 89% stake in NewsWatch Inc. NewsWatch reported profit of ¥30 million on revenue of ¥1.1 billion for the year ending March 2005. The transaction is expected to complete on March 31, 2006.

deals.sellers: Globis Capital Partners Co., Ltd.; DG Ventures, Inc.
deals.comment: Yahoo Japan Corp. (TSE: 4689) agreed to acquire 89.5% stake in Interscope Inc. from DG Incubation and Apax Globis Japan Fund, fund of Globis Capital Partners on January 24, 2007, for a purchase price of ¥1.26 billion. Interscope Inc. had net sales were ¥1.009 billion, gross profit of ¥555 million, operating income of ¥66 million, ordinary income of ¥69 million, net loss of ¥151 million, total assets of ¥836 million for the period ending June 30, 2006. The total number of shares outstanding for Interscope Inc. is 0.006 million shares.

Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE: 4689) signed a memorandum of understanding to acquire Overture KK from Yahoo Inc (NASDAQ: YHOO) on April 24, 2007. The purchased price is subject to negotiations. Latham & Watkins acted as legal advisor to Overture and Stuart Beraha, Susan Glenn, Andrew Morrison, Saori Nakamura, Jay Ponazecki, Bill Veatch and Stanley Yukevich of Morrison & Foerster, LLP acted as legal advisors to Yahoo Japan.
